## Objective
- Transform the existing Castle Defender game into a playable cyberpunk-themed defense game with new hero visuals, outfits, weapons, helper drones, larger enemies, and day/night gameplay.

- User requested: “change main hero to cyberpunk, change arrows to cyberpunk, add outfits different types, add helpers to castle as additional skill. add bigger opponents. add emoji over upcoming opponents. make day and night. add firepit. add starfall. add different guns.”
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

- Assumed a neon cyberpunk castle-defense aesthetic, four switchable weapons, helper drones, and an automatic day/night cycle.

- Added cyberpunk branding, battle labels, and controls in `index.html`.
- Added cyberpunk hero/projectile/castle visuals, outfits, four weapons, outfit/weapon persistence, opponent emoji queue, larger boss enemies, firepit, day/night scenery, Starfall area damage, and helper-drone combat in `game.js`.
- Styled the new interface and controls in `style.css`.
- Changed page title/footer branding and moved game persistence to `neonKeepSave`, with fallback loading from `enchantedKeepSave`.
- Fixed `drawArrow`; `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.
